sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Hot Delivery is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hey, brother! You're an experienced fighter, you can stop by my place without a second thought. But my other clients aren't so lucky. One of them was found lying in a pool of blood at the gas station. Looks like someone had been watching him. Now the rest are spooked and don't want to be seen carrying cash. Seems like someone's keeping an eye on anyone who looks like they've got money. My clients don't want to expose themselves anymore, so they stay out of sight. Doesn't hurt business, though. If you don't come to the goods, the goods will come to you! Do me a favor, brother. Get the gear my guys need and stash it on Interchange. Leave one set consisting of a 6B47 helmet and a Peltor ComTac 2 headset in the trash at Avokado. Then stash one gray Gzhel armor in the trash near the outdoor stage, right across from Ultra's main entrance. I won't forget the favor, trust me."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Must reach Loyalty Level 2 with Ragman to obtain this quest.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Stash a ComTac II headset in the specified place on Interchange
- Stash a 6B47 helmet (Olive Drab) in the specified place on Interchange
- Stash a Gzhel-K body armor in the specified place on Interchange

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- Ragman Rep +0.25
- 165,000 Roubles
  - 173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"The guys said they got the stuff, nicely done, brother. Told you, all smooth and quick. As promised, here's your reward."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Peltor ComTac II headset (OD Green) | 1 | Required | N/A | Placed item |
| 6B47 Ratnik-BSh helmet (Olive Drab) | 1 | Required | N/A | Placed item |
| BNTI Gzhel-K body armor | 1 | Required | N/A | Placed item |
The headset and the helmet must be placed in a garbage pile in the "Avokado" store. The EMR cover and EMR Arctic cover variants of the 6B47 helmet can not be used.

The body armor must be placed outside the mall, in a garbage pile next to the stage in front of the "ULTRA" store. Armor plates can be removed to reduce weight.
